svg.text: Loss: CrossEntropyLoss on local partition (Non-IID split)
Evaluate Local Validation Set → Extract 3 Metrics
12.96 KB model weights + 3 metric scalars (no raw data)
⚡ Privacy: Only gradient weights cross the boundary
No GPS, no zone IDs, no individual trajectories are transmitted
STEP 3 · COMPUTE 4 ADAPTIVE FACTORS PER CLIENT
Weight Normalization — Ensures Unbiased Convex Combination
Global Parameter Aggregation — Layer-Wise Weighted Sum
Applied layer-by-layer: each layer tensor is separately weighted and summed across all K clients
Shape assertion enforced: each aggregated layer must match client parameter shape
Updated Global Model w_{t+1} → All 8 Clients
12.96 KB download per client · 207.36 KB total per round · 30 training rounds
Each client initializes next epoch from this updated global model — federated loop continues
Aggregation logs written to CSV: round, region_id, dataset_size, val_macro_f1, ema_f1, quality, rare_fraction, rarity_bonus, gate, raw_weight, normalized_weight
